summary: Comprehensive testing of Accompagn'Santé application - French consulting platform for workplace accident/occupational disease counseling. Tested new homepage features, new pages (Tarifs, Séminaires, Entreprises, Partenaires, Avis), navigation dropdowns, testimonial system with admin validation, and backend APIs.

minor_bugs.issue: FAQ category endpoint returns 404 - URL encoding issue with AT/MP category
minor_bugs.impact: FAQ filtering by category may not work for AT/MP
minor_bugs.workaround: Need to use URL encoded path: AT%2FMP

ui_bugs.issue: Services dropdown click intercepted by overlay - timeout on click

integration_issues.issue: Modal overlay prevents clicking star rating buttons after form fill
integration_issues.impact: User may have difficulty completing testimonial submission

passed_tests: Homepage loads with 'Service pionnier en France' badge
Tarifs page displays 4 pricing cards for particuliers + 2 for pro
Séminaires page loads with correct format options
Testimonial form opens and accepts input

Admin tabs for Contacts and Avis functional
Avis creation and approval workflow working
Admin authentication and token system working
